      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies error handling in src/index/ base and derived index classes (txindex, blockfilterindex, coinstatsindex, txospenderindex), making index point-read failures fatal.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents secondary indexes from silently returning bad data or masking corruption during point reads. The PR description notes that previously 'a corrupt txindex point read can consequently fail one RPC while the node continues running' with bad state."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/kernel/chainstatemanager_opts.h are minor option plumbing following the coins view and fatal callback refactoring, not a kernel boundary change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member; changes to kernel headers are mechanical adjustments supporting validation changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h are mechanical single-line adjustments following the coins view method signature changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member; touched files reflect mechanical call-site updates rather than mempool policy or data structure modifications."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test runner and coins/dbwrapper unit and functional tests verify the new error handling rather than altering shared test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Non-member; test changes follow the feature implementation and do not alter general test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "CDBWrapper and LevelDB interaction are explicitly categorized under validation rather than utilities.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member; database wrapper logic falls under validation according to category definitions."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label, alters src/dbwrapper, src/txdb, and src/coins, and modifies chainstate view error handling.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures database corruption is treated as fatal rather than masquerading as missing keys. Commit e80ce4c088 notes that 'CDBWrapper::Read() throws on a LevelDB failure without running the read-error callback and reports a corrupt value as a missing key,' and eliminating CCoinsViewErrorCatcher directly clarifies the coins cache stack."
    }
